form-field.expects: renders its floating label from a `<label slot="label">` and its control (an `input`/`textarea` or an m3e form control) from the default slot; associate them yourself with `for`=<control id> — the component does NO id-wiring. (A default-slot `<label for=id>` sibling also works.) Prefix/suffix/hint/error use their named slots.

select.expects: admits `m3e-option` children in its default slot, and groups them under `m3e-optgroup` (each group takes a `<span slot="label">` group label); a custom dropdown arrow goes in `slot="arrow"`.
